explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/422: 'It is not even known whether f(n) is well-defined for all n.' The Lean statement ∃ f : ℕ+ → ℕ+, IsHofstadterQ f is equivalent to well-definedness: the predicate forces the initial values, the recurrence, and that the arguments n − f(n−1), n − f(n−2) are positive integers at every step, and conversely a well-defined sequence gives such an f. Faithful.
